title: Injectivity of the exit-state map
statement: For every type $S$ and every fixed state $s\in S$, the map from counter phases to clock states that sends the true completed phase to the body state at $s$, the false completed phase to the timeout state carrying $s$, and every other phase to the decrement state carrying $s$ and that phase is injective.
